name: Felix Liu
title: Senior Data Engineer | Cloud Engineer | AI Engineer
bio: Data Engineering leader with 10+ years delivering cloud-scale data platforms across financial services, media, and SaaS. Expert in modernising legacy ecosystems, building high-reliability pipelines, and driving measurable improvements in cost, quality, and performance. Known for turning complex data environments into scalable, governed, business-critical platforms.

Led the MLA project, architecting and building an advanced, scalable data platform on AWS.
Executed data transformation for IAG and delivered cloud engineering solutions for The Coffee Club.
Designed and built end-to-end BI solutions utilizing the full Microsoft stack.
